audit.whatIsWrong: Five strings claim Pantheon's passive blocks Nasus's auto-attacks: early "his passive blocks your Q autos outright", spikes[1].text "passive auto-blocks", wants.foe[1] "Block your Q autos with his passive", whys[0] "his passive blocks your Q autos", whys[2] "his passive block and Q poke".
audit.why: Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will — 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' It blocks nothing. The damage block belongs to Aegis Assault (E), which sets his shield and makes him invulnerable to damage from the front while he strikes. The distinction is the entire counterplay: a passive that always blocks autos means Nasus can never trade, which is what the text currently implies, whereas a directional block on a 22/21/20/19/18s cooldown means Nasus should walk around him or simply wait it out. The content also correctly refers to his 'empowered Q spears', which is Mortal Will working as it actually does, so the file contradicts itself.
audit.corrected: Mortal Will empowers his next spell. Aegis Assault (E) is the block, it only covers the front, and it is a 22s cooldown at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer never names one Pantheon ability — the packet's flagged defect — and Grand Starfall is absent entirely.
audit.why: Mortal Will, Comet Spear, Shield Vault, Aegis Assault and Grand Starfall appear nowhere; the text says only "his W", "Q poke", "W-Q-AA". Grand Starfall matters beyond naming: it is a 5500-range leap on a 180/165/150s cooldown, so at 6 Pantheon's most likely play is to leave the lane and cash his lead somewhere else. A Nasus who is told only that level 6 'evens out' will not ward for the roam or warn the map.
audit.corrected: Name all five and flag Grand Starfall as a map-wide roam tool, not a duel tool.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns lists Shield Vault twice as two separate entries and carries no numbers.
audit.why: Duplicated boilerplate, the same bug that appears in the Nautilus entry. Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9s at 600 range and Aegis Assault is 22/21/20/19/18s — the longest non-ultimate cooldown either champion has and the real window to walk at him.
audit.corrected: One entry each, with the real numbers, and the frontal-only note on Aegis Assault.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] reads "He out-poks and out-trades you levels 4-5".

edits.before: Pantheon owns these levels and you cannot fight him — his W is a point-click stun that locks you for his empowered Q spear combo, and his passive blocks your Q autos outright, so trading back is a losing proposition. Just soak Q farm and eat the Q poke; don't step up to last-hit into a stun you can't answer. The one thing in your favor is your Soul Eater lifesteal heals the chip damage between his cooldowns, so as long as you don't die you stay even on the map.
edits.after: Pantheon owns these levels and you cannot fight him — Shield Vault (W) is a point-click stun that locks you for his empowered Comet Spear, and Mortal Will empowers every few casts. His passive does not block autos; Aegis Assault (E) does, and only from the front. Just soak Q farm and eat the poke; don't step up into a stun you can't answer. Soul Eater lifesteal heals the chip between his cooldowns, so as long as you don't die you stay even.

edits.before: Level 3 Wither is your first real tool — when he commits W-Q-AA, slam Wither to gut his attack speed and movement so the all-in falls apart and he can't follow up or kite away. You still lose extended trades to his passive block and poke, so use Wither defensively to survive rather than to start fights. At 6, Fury of the Sands plus Wither flips a committed all-in: the bonus HP and AoE burn let you turn his dive into a kill instead of a death, and that's when the lane starts to even out.
edits.after: Level 3 Wither is your first real tool — when he commits Shield Vault into Comet Spear, slam Wither to gut his attack speed and movement so the all-in falls apart and he can't kite away. Aegis Assault only blocks damage from the front, so walk around him rather than beating on the shield, and note it is a 22s cooldown at rank 1. At 6 Fury of the Sands plus Wither flips a committed all-in, but expect him to spend Grand Starfall roaming rather than duelling you.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — His all-in start. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Pantheon Shield Vault: Leaps to a target, stuns, and strikes — his all-in start. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Pantheon Shield Vault (W): matchup-defining — 13/12/11/10/9s point-click dash stun at 600 range. Bait it. - Pantheon Aegis Assault (E): 22-18s, blocks damage from the front only — walk around it, don't hit into it.

notes: The passive-blocks-autos claim is stale by several years — that was Aegis Protection, replaced by Mortal Will in Pantheon's rework — and it appeared in five strings, so a player would treat it as settled fact. Worth grepping the rest of the dataset for the same claim in other champions' Pantheon entries. One thing I deliberately did not write: Aegis Assault carries a channel flag reading 'interruptible — any CC cancels it', but Nasus has no hard CC in his kit — Wither is a slow and slows do not interrupt channels — so I gave the frontal-angle counterplay instead of an interrupt the player cannot actually perform. The packet's suspectName "No Wither" in whys[0] is a false positive.
